notes: Adds the head-commit Cross-Unit-Move trailer to the unit-ownership guard: every foreign path listed with its actual owning unit and a D or M status, at least one new file in the declaring unit's namespace, every listed delete paired with a same-basename add, and every listed modification paired with a same-basename delete. Empty or malformed manifests, unlisted foreign paths, wrong owners, added foreign path listings, moves without a counterpart and modifications without a delete fail closed with a named reason; the rest of the guard is unchanged. Tests cover the allowed evidence-namespace and map-owned moves plus each failure mode. The protected scripts/port change is authorised by the captain through oracle-change, who reviews the manifest by hand against the diff; aggregates are parent-owned.
